events.title: MTV launches 45 years ago
events.blurb: MTV, Music Television, launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' "Video Killed The Radio Star" being the very first music video ever aired on the channel.

angles.name: MTV Launch Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the day music TV changed everything? 45 years ago today, MTV hit the airwaves, kicking off with The Buggles. What was the first music video that truly blew your mind?

events.title: Oasis' Definitely Maybe turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis released their seminal debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994, which quickly became the fastest-selling debut album in British history.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Anniversary
angles.copy: 32 years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the game. Which track from their iconic debut still gets you singing along the loudest?

events.title: Woodstock Festival began 57 years ago
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, began on August 15, 1969, attracting over 400,000 people for "3 Days of Peace & Music."

angles.name: Woodstock Anniversary
angles.copy: 57 years ago today, the Woodstock Festival kicked off, bringing together half a million people for three days of peace, love, and legendary music. Imagine being there!

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Today marks 49 years since the passing of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have been 91 this year.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: 49 years ago today, the world lost a legend. Remembering Elvis Presley, whose music and charisma continue to captivate generations. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: On September 13, 1996, the world tragically lost influential rapper Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55 this year.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: Today marks 30 years since we lost one of hip-hop's most impactful voices. Remembering Tupac Shakur, whose lyrics and legacy continue to resonate deeply.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: The music world lost guitar virtuoso Jimi Hendrix on September 18, 1970, who would have been 84 years old today.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: 56 years ago, we said goodbye to a true pioneer. Remembering Jimi Hendrix, whose groundbreaking guitar work forever changed music.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on September 26, 1969, featuring some of their most beloved tracks and that legendary zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: 57 years ago today, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. From 'Come Together' to 'Here Comes the Sun', which track is your favourite from this masterpiece?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th birthday to the iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde, born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and songwriting have given us decades of incredible music.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Happy 54th birthday to the unmistakable voice of Oasis, Liam Gallagher, born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Whether with Oasis or solo, his swagger and voice are truly iconic. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' single turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless single 'Imagine' on October 11, 1971, a song that became his best-selling solo single and a global anthem for peace.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: 55 years ago, John Lennon gave the world 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity is as powerful today as it was then. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: The original iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the revolutionary first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, changing how millions of people listened to music forever.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the first time you held an iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple launched the device that put '1,000 songs in your pocket' and redefined portable music.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th is officially James Bond Day, celebrating the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, what's your favourite thing about 007?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today would have been the 86th birthday of the legendary Beatles co-founder, John Lennon, born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the incomparable John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations worldwide.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary English actor, comedian, and writer, John Cleese, born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is truly unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' White Album turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968, showcasing the band's diverse and experimental sound.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that proved they could do anything. What's your hidden gem from this double LP?
